chunks: And Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said:
“You have been commanded to perform hajj and 'umrah, so do not be concerned with which of the two you begin with.”

key_terms.الْحَجِّ: hajj, the major pilgrimage to the Sacred House

ai.seo_question: Does it matter whether one begins with hajj or 'umrah?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام states that both hajj and 'umrah have been commanded. The hadith indicates that one should not be troubled about which of the two is begun first, expressing a practical ruling related to the rites of pilgrimage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3131 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"You have been commanded to perform Hajj and Umrah, so do not worry about which one you begin with."
